headlines.description: — The Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Denver Nuggets at their own game Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 25 points and leads Thunder past Denver 92-87 to tie series 2-2

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets

headlines.description: — The Indiana Pacers spent two days looking for solutions against top-seeded Cleveland.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pacers build 41-point halftime lead and rout Cavaliers 129-109 for a 3-1 series lead
